description: Defines a Java class ApiError used for standard error responses in the API, including fields like timestamp, status, code, message, path, and optional validation details.

classes.name: ApiError
classes.description: A POJO representing a standard API error response, including error details, timestamp, status code, and optional validation error details.

methods.name: ApiError (constructor)
methods.description: Constructor initializing all fields of the ApiError object.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of when the error occurred.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code associated with the error.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the API request path where the error occurred.

methods.name: getDetails
methods.description: Returns optional validation error details as a map.

methods.name: setTimestamp
methods.description: Sets the timestamp of the error.

methods.name: setDetails
methods.description: Sets the validation error details map.
